rounds.text: The company is experiencing a clear top-line slowdown, evidenced by compounded sales growth dropping to 2% over 3 years and contracting by 7% over the trailing twelve months [E16, E17], alongside a poor 5-year sales growth rate of 6.89% [E60]. Profitability growth has similarly stalled in the medium term, with compounded profit growth declining by 10% over 3 years and 12% over the trailing twelve months [E20, E21], accompanied by a deteriorating long-term yearly operating margin trend that has fallen from 17% to 10% over the last three years [E30, E32]. Market sentiment and price action strongly reflect these fundamental headwinds, as the stock languishes 50.8% away from its 52-week high, trades below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E48, E49], and has delivered a twelve-month price return of -23.3% [E51] accompanied by an annualized volatility of 60.7% [E53]. Furthermore, historical downside risk is extreme, highlighted by a worst peak-to-trough drawdown of -83.8% [E52], while shareholder returns via dividends remain suppressed at just 10.9% of profits over the last 3 years [E61]. Conceded: [E44].
